settings.heading: Kids Rugs That Feel Like Home (Even on Messy Days)
settings.row_content:
If you’ve ever watched a child sit on the floor - legs crossed, toys scattered, completely lost in their own little world - you already know something important.

The floor matters.

That’s where stories happen.
 That’s where blocks fall, crayons roll, naps sneak in, and tiny feet learn balance.

At Indian Rug Store, we don’t think of kids rugs as décor pieces. We think of them as quiet companions to childhood. Soft enough for bare skin. Strong enough for everyday chaos. And made with the kind of care you’d expect if it were for our own children.

Every rug you see here is handmade in Jaipur, just like we’ve been doing since 1990.

settings.heading: Made in Jaipur, the Way It’s Always Been Done
settings.row_content:
We’re based where the looms live.

Not in offices far away.
 Not through layers of suppliers.

Our rugs are woven in-house, by artisans in Jaipur who’ve spent their lives learning how yarn behaves, how knots hold, how a rug ages over time. Some of them are parents. Some are grandparents. All of them understand that a rug for a child needs a little extra thought.

When you buy a kids rug from us, it hasn’t passed through ten hands.
 It’s gone from loom → finishing → your home.

That’s how we keep quality honest - and prices fair.

settings.heading: Soft, Safe Materials (Because Kids Live on the Floor)
settings.row_content:
Kids don’t just walk on rugs.
 They lie on them. Roll on them. Nap on them. Spill juice on them.

So we keep materials simple and trustworthy.

Our children’s rugs are made using natural fibers we’ve worked with for decades:

  • Hand-knotted wool – naturally soft, warm, and resilient
  • Cotton kilims – light, breathable, and easy to live with
  • Jute dhurries – sturdy, earthy, and eco-friendly
  • Gentle, low-impact dyes that don’t overpower a room

No sharp textures.
 No plastic shine.
 Nothing that feels wrong the moment your child sits down.

If you’re setting up a baby’s room, our neutral nursery rugs are a favorite - calm colors, low pile, and nothing loud or busy.

settings.heading: Designs That Don’t Talk Down to Kids (or Parents)
settings.row_content:
Here’s something we’ve noticed over the years.

Kids don’t need cartoon overload.
 And parents don’t want rugs they’ll outgrow in a year.

So we design with restraint.

Soft patterns. Friendly shapes. Colors that feel happy but not noisy. Rugs that fit into a child’s room today - and still make sense a few years from now.

You’ll find:

  • Gentle patterns for nursery rugs
  • Playful but grounded designs for children’s bedrooms
  • Calm tones that help rooms feel settled, not chaotic

These rugs don’t shout. They stay.

settings.heading: Rugs Made for Real Homes, Not Catalogs
settings.row_content:
Let’s be practical for a moment.

Kids spill things.
 They drag chairs.
 They forget to wipe their feet.

Our rugs are made with that reality in mind.

Tight weaves. Strong edges. Yarns that hold their shape. Many parents tell us they were surprised how well these rugs age—even after years of use.

They don’t stay “perfect.”
 They stay useful.

And honestly, that’s better.

settings.heading: Choosing the Right Kids Rug (Simple Advice)
settings.row_content:
If you’re unsure, here’s what we usually tell parents:

For nurseries:
 Soft wool or cotton. Low pile. Calm colors.

For toddlers:
 Durable cotton kilims or tightly woven wool.

For shared rooms:
 Choose patterns that blend into your home—not something you’ll want to hide later.

Size matters:
 A slightly bigger rug always works better than a small one kids outgrow.

And if you’re still confused, just ask. We’re real people on the other side.

settings.heading: A Rug That Becomes Part of Their Story
settings.row_content:
Years from now, the rug might be faded.
 Corners a little soft.
 Edges worn in places.

But it will have been there - through playtime, quiet mornings, growing years.

That’s what we make rugs for.

Explore our handmade kids rug collection and find one that feels right for your child, your home, and your way of living.

settings.heading: What materials are best for kids rugs?
settings.row_content: Soft natural fibers like wool and cotton and stain-resistant synthetics are ideal. Wool is resilient and hypoallergenic; cotton is breathable and easy to care for; synthetic blends are durable and easy to clean.

settings.heading: How do I choose the right size kids rug?
settings.row_content: Measure the area you want covered -  a slightly larger rug defines play zones better. Ensure it fits under furniture or leaves enough clear floor around it.

settings.heading: Are kids rugs safe for toddlers and babies?
settings.row_content: Yes, choose non-toxic, hypoallergenic materials, low-pile surfaces, and non-slip backing to keep babies safe while crawling and playing.

settings.heading: Why choose low-pile or flatweave rugs for kids?
settings.row_content: Low-pile rugs are easier to clean, less likely to trap crumbs and dust, and more comfortable for play and crawling.

settings.heading: How do I clean a kids rug?
settings.row_content: Vacuum regularly, spot clean spills with mild soap and water, and follow care instructions  -  some are machine washable, others need gentle handling.
